item.title: Carney Wins; Canada Loses: Unpacking Election 2025 [Liberty Dispatch]
item.description:
Liberty Dispatch ~ May 01, 2025
In this episode of Liberty Dispatch, hosts Andrew DeBartolo and Matthew Hallick unpack the results of the Canadian election 2025. 

Subscribe or follow our new Substack page: https://ldcanada.substack.com/;
